_ordering_rationale: American Express = reseau ferme proprio cards + credit + merchant acquiring. KPIs ordres: Billed Business (coeur volume), Discount Revenue (#1 revenue line), Network Volumes, Cards-in-force, Net Card Fees (subscription).

kpis.signal: Volume facture proprietary cards: doublement 2020->2024 (COVID rebond + Millennials/GenZ adoption). $1.55 trillions
kpis.description_fr: Volume facture sur cartes proprietaires Amex (spending). Indicateur cle business model: chaque dollar facture genere discount revenue + cross-sell credit + lifetime CM. Coeur PV.
kpis.description_en: Billed business on Amex proprietary cards (spending). Key business model metric: each dollar generates discount revenue + credit cross-sell + CM lifetime value. Core thesis.

kpis.signal: Source revenu #1: commissions merchants ~2.34% du billed. Marge tres elevee, gros levier sur volume
kpis.description_fr: Discount revenue: commissions percues sur les commercants quand Card Member depense. Source de revenu #1 Amex (53% du CA total non-interest). Taux ~2.34%.
kpis.description_en: Discount revenue: merchant fees collected when Card Member spends. #1 Amex revenue source (53% of non-interest revenue). ~2.34% rate.

kpis.signal: Volumes totaux (proprietary + GNS processed). Reseau ferme premium, monetisation par discount rate + frais cards
kpis.description_fr: Volumes totaux reseau Amex (billed business proprietary + processed volumes GNS). Mesure la portee end-to-end de la plateforme.
kpis.description_en: Total Amex network volumes (proprietary billed + GNS processed). Measures end-to-end platform reach.

kpis.signal: Croissance +31% sur 5 ans (jeunes generations 60% nouveaux comptes). 83.6 M proprietary FY24
kpis.description_fr: Cartes en circulation mondialement (proprietary + GNS). Base d'utilisateurs qui multiplie le billed business. Millennials/GenZ = ~60% des nouveaux comptes.
kpis.description_en: Worldwide cards-in-force (proprietary + GNS). User base that drives billed business. Millennials/GenZ = ~60% of new accounts.

kpis.signal: +81% sur 5 ans, monetisation premium cards (Platinum, Gold) avec refresh + retention >95%
kpis.description_fr: CA des cotisations annuelles cartes. Mesure le pricing power Amex sur cartes premium et le mix. Croissance soutenue par card refresh strategy.
kpis.description_en: Annual card fee revenue. Measures Amex pricing power on premium cards and mix. Sustained growth via card refresh strategy.
